description: Investigate a Django web application at /home/ga/workspace/webapp/ that works on macOS but fails on Ubuntu Linux. The app crashes with 'FileNotFoundError: static/CSS/main.css' on Linux. Your task is to identify ALL environment-specific issues and create a diagnostic report. Specifically: (1) Find case-sensitivity issues in imports and file paths (macOS is case-insensitive, Linux is case-sensitive), (2) Find hardcoded absolute paths that won't work across different machines, (3) Create a report at /home/ga/workspace/webapp/DIAGNOSTIC_REPORT.md documenting each issue with the file location, description of the problem, why it causes cross-platform failures, and recommended fix. Investigate views.py, settings.py, and templates/index.html carefully. You do NOT need to fix the code, just document the issues clearly.

metadata.real_world_scenario: Collaborative development across different operating systems
